text: This report seeks approval from City Council to amend City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 950, Traffic and Parking, to convert the existing parking prohibition in effect within the vicinity of fire halls to "No Stopping Anytime" and to amend Code Chapter 610, Penalties, Administration of, to increase the existing no stopping penalty from $40.00 to $60.00. In addition, this report seeks approval to amend City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 903, Parking for Persons with Disabilities, by removing the current prohibition (captured in Section (5) of § 903-6C) for persons with Accessible Parking Permits from parking within 7.5 metres of a fire hall on the same side of the road and within 30.5 metres on the opposite side of the road, as this provision would become redundant. City Council on June 18 and 19, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 950, Traffic and Parking, by deleting Section 950-400E (6) which provides that, where authorized signs to that effect are displayed, no person shall park any vehicle on any highway within a distance of up to 7.5 metres of any fire hall on the side of the highway on which the fire hall is located or within a distance of up to 30.5 metres of such fire hall on the opposite side of the highway. 2.
